story_theme_en: A main road is 12 meters wide with sidewalks on both sides, each 2.5 meters wide. The area between the two sidewalks is the road surface. How wide is the road surface? If a center divider 2 meters wide is built in the middle of the road surface, how wide is each side of the road surface?
helper_tip: Parallel lines are lines that stay the same distance apart and never meet.
hint_th: เส้นขนานคือเส้นที่มีระยะห่างเท่ากันตลอดและไม่ตัดกัน

data.content_en: A main road is 12 meters wide with sidewalks on both sides, each 2.5 meters wide. The area between the two sidewalks is the road surface. How wide is the road surface? If a center divider 2 meters wide is built in the middle of the road surface, how wide is each side of the road surface?

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Road surface = 12 - (2 × 2.5) = 7 meters | Each side of road surface = (7 − 2) ÷ 2 = 2.5 meters

data.content_en: Road surface = 12 - (2 × 2.5) = 7 meters | Each side of road surface = (7 − 2) ÷ 2 = 2.5 meters
